title: Adding Root Certificates for Zero Trust Browser in Internet & SaaS

blocks.text: The default Zscaler Root Certificate is deployed automatically as a placeholder root certificate for any new isolation profile. However, you can add your own root certificates to use for isolation profiles instead.
To add an Internet & SaaS (ZIA) root certificate:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Internet Access > Resources > Root Certificates.
The Add Root Certificate drawer opens.
In the Add Root Certificate drawer:
For the Type of certificate, select Browser Isolation from the drop-down menu.
For Content, browse your computer to choose a PEM file.
The new root certificate appears in the page list.

blocks.text: You can add up to 10 root certificates for your organization. After adding them, you can edit a root certificate that is not the default and not associated with an isolation profile.
To deploy root certificates to isolation profiles, see Creating Isolation Profiles for Internet & SaaS and Editing an Isolation Profile for Internet & SaaS.
